decisions.reason: The cleaning soap gained its own web page in 2024, a sign of growing visible commitment, and it fits the firm's announced care-and-maintenance offering, so management will persist with it.
The maintenance oil is a low-cost complement to the firm's oiled floors and has stayed consistently visible, so there is little reason to abandon the investment and the commitment already made.
The care product for oiled floors was promoted to its own page in 2024, showing increased public commitment that management would want to justify rather than reverse.

The moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory that supports flooring system sales and the technical guidance promise, so any weak results are likely to be blamed on temporary market conditions.
The high-density foam underlay rounds out the accessory range, though it overlaps somewhat with D and so carries slightly more risk of being rationalised.
Oak parquet is central to the firm's core business and to its production investments, so management would strongly persist with it.
